subject: Post-call: Crestware pilot checklist & decision cadence
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
To: Anya Feldman <anya@crestware.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: Crestware pilot checklist & decision cadence

Hi Anya — thanks for the call today. Quick written recap and suggested next steps so we have a single source of truth. I attached a short pilot scope PDF and a sheet of sample prompts.

Summary of what we agreed:
- Goal: validate LLM-based customer support summarization in production-like conditions and measure cost/latency at scale.
- Pilot window: 4 weeks (following a 1–2 week sandbox prep).
- Key success checkpoints (proposed):
  • Latency: p95 < 200 ms for <=512-token requests (baseline for live UI responsiveness)
  • Throughput: sustain 50 req/s with no more than 5% queueing at peak
  • Cost: target blended cost <= $0.0025 per token (including caching/batching benefits)
  • Quality: 85%+ usefulness score on our joint prompt set (sample prompts attached) — objective is human-rated utility for summaries
- Data: Crestware will provide an anonymized 3k-message sample for smoke validation and a 25k subset for pilot load tests.
- Ownership: Jordan (sales) -> commercial cadence & kickoff; Ben (pilot eng) -> infra config, batch settings, quantization profile; Monica (CS) -> success metrics, collection of human evals and admin access.

Immediate asks / proposed timeline:
1) Confirm kickoff week: proposed Monday 2026-12-06 for sandbox access and a short tech onboarding (30–60m).
2) Crestware to upload sample data and share SFTP/Drive link + any IAM constraints (we requested a read-only dataset in the Drive folder).
3) Ben & engineering to prepare a quick smoke run (first 5k tokens) within 48 hours of receiving data.
4) We’ll run a mid-pilot check (week 2) to assess latency and token spend; if either misses target we’ll adjust batching/cache and re-run.

Can you confirm the proposed kickoff date and the data delivery timeline? Also calling out two attachments: crestware-pilot-scope-v1.pdf and crestware-sample-prompts.xlsx.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0172

From: Anya Feldman <anya@crestware.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Crestware pilot checklist & decision cadence

Jordan — thanks for the clear recap, this is very helpful. Confirming that the goals listed match our internal expectations with two small notes:
1) Quality metric: instead of a single % usefulness threshold, can we split into: extractive accuracy (entity capture) >= 88% and qualitative summary usefulness >= 80%? That helps our analytics and customer success teams.
2) Cost target: $0.0025/token is ambitious — we can accept that as a pilot SLA but would like visibility into how caching/batching assumptions map to our real user mix.

We can aim to kick off on Monday 2026-12-06. I’ll have our data engineering lead upload the anonymized 3k sample to the Drive folder by EOD Friday (2026-12-04). I’m also attaching our security questionnaire (crestware-security-ask.pdf) — Ben, Monica, please review any quick asks we should answer before sandbox access.

Availability for the sandbox onboarding:
- Mon 12/06: 10:00–11:00 PT (preferred)
- Tue 12/07: 14:00–15:00 PT

If the timing works, please send a calendar invite.

— Anya
Director of Product Operations | Crestware AI
anya@crestware.ai | +1 646-555-9021

Subject: Re: Post-call: Crestware pilot checklist & decision cadence

Looping in Karthik for infra planning. Quick tech notes / asks from my side:
- We should validate two model variants during the smoke run: a quantized LLM (8-bit) and a fp16 baseline. This will give us realistic latency vs quality tradeoffs.
- Request: Crestware please include a small representative peak-hour burst file (CSV of request timestamps) so we can emulate concurrency patterns for throughput tests.
- For cost modeling: I’ll run a short token-cost simulation after the week-1 smoke run and share a simple spreadsheet mapping batch sizes / cache hit rates to per-token effective cost.
- Security doc: I’ll triage crestware-security-ask.pdf and share answers within 48 hours.

Action items I’m taking:
- Prepare two runtime profiles (quantized + fp16) and a default batching policy tuned for 512-token median payloads.
- Schedule a 45m tech onboarding with Crestware on Mon 12/06 at 10:00 PT (I’ll propose a calendar invite).

Ben

Thanks everyone — quick consolidated plan below and next steps (finalized):
- Kickoff: Mon 2026-12-06, 10:00 PT (sandbox onboarding) — calendar invite sent.
- Data delivery: Crestware to upload anonymized 3k sample by 2026-12-04 (Anya confirmed). Crestware to also send peak-hour burst CSV within 48 hours of upload.
- Week 0 (sandbox): Ben to run smoke run (5k tokens) and report latency + first-pass quality by Wed 12/09.
- Week 1–4 (pilot): sustained throughput and cost tracking; mid-pilot checkpoint at day 14 to assess gating conditions.
- Owners: Jordan (commercial), Ben (runtime & perf), Monica (success & human evals), Karthik (ops readiness).

Decision cadence: if mid-pilot metrics miss targets (latency p95 or cost higher than modeled), we’ll triage in a 30m pause-and-fix call and agree on remediations (cache tuning, smaller batch sizes, alternative quantization). If we fail to get within 10% of targets after remediations, Crestware may choose to extend pilot for two weeks or pause.

Follow-ups I’ll track in HubSpot: CRE-452 (link below). I’ll also upload Ben’s initial cost simulation and a short runbook to the Drive folder after the smoke run.

Links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/CRE-452; https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-crestware-pilot

Thanks — looking forward to kickoff.
